verdict.rationale: Cooley's own compensation and benefits practice page claims broad experience with all aspects of compensation and benefits programs for startups. Community commentary notes that Cooley GO posts cover equity incentive tax issues. However, no evidence explicitly describes designing option plans, and local schemes are absent entirely. Missing for 10: explicit stock option/equity incentive plan design pages, UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, Indian ESOP coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: Broad experience with all aspects of compensation and benefits programs for clients ranging from startups and emerging growth companies to large public companies
posts on FAQs like allocating initial founder equity and equity incentive tax issues
